summary: 30-hour in-person build sprint in Munich with about 200 builders on blockchain and AI, with agentic payments as the theme. Part of the TUM Blockchain Conference.
eligibility: Open worldwide, not limited to TUM students. Solo or teams of up to 5; each member applies separately on Devfolio. Free, though a deposit may be announced.
title: TUM Blockchain & AI Hackathon 2026

prize.description: EUR 10,000: EUR 4,000 from BSV Association and EUR 6,000 from Cardano; per-place breakdown not yet published.

notes: Build starts 30 Oct; submissions close 31 Oct.
